description: Save the person's answer to one screening question an employer's form asks, so automatic applications can send it — use the question's wording from auto_apply_get. The answer is sent to employers in the person's name: pass on what THEY said, never an answer you composed or guessed. Replaces an earlier answer to the same question.

answer.description: The person's answer, in their words.

question.description: The question as the form words it.

name: answer_bank_save
title: Save a screening answer
